entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent provider offers a universal memory layer with multi-level support for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud, self-hosted server, or an Apache-2.0 SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve a 91% token reduction and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging context paths.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform enables persistent long-term memory across agent sessions by building self-hosted knowledge graphs from text and code. It supports Python 3.10–3.14 and is designed for both local and cloud deployments.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain provides an opinionated memory system that extracts typed entity edges without requiring LLM calls. It includes a 24/7 daemon for autonomous memory consolidation and features privacy-verified local storage with multi-user data scoping.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, this engine sustains sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month using a custom vector graph engine. It features automated fact extraction, byte-level deduplication for prompt-cache discounts, and native connectors for platforms like Google Drive and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agents learn over time. It supports over 25 LLM providers and offers flexible deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud services with SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents, serving as the upstream logic for the Hermes self-hosted wrapper. It provides a FastAPI-based core service with Python and TypeScript SDKs to manage sessions and peer interactions.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider manages memory as a git-like repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, achieving sub-100ms response times.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that uses episodic compression to achieve sub-linear storage growth. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration with tools like Cursor and Claude Code while maintaining sub-millisecond performance.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This system implements a seven-layer memory architecture for Hermes, including vector search on Qdrant and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context and runs on local infrastructure via Docker and Redis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts like traces and playbooks to assist with complex tasks. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to verify the effectiveness of context changes.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agents using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise detail recovery from the message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from over twenty coding agents to enable millisecond lookups and natural-language search over months of past data. It ensures model safety by automatically redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend for private cross-session memory that supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM or local inference server. It includes an automated setup script for deploying Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis to maintain persistent agent state.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI maintains a living semantic ontology through a background process called dreaming to provide portable state across multiple agent clients. It supports real-time ingestion from external sources like Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub to build a local-first identity and memory layer.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer stores information as human-readable YAML files on local disk using the open engram format. It utilizes a hybrid search approach, combining BM25 and local embeddings, to retrieve context for MCP-integrated tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP and dedicated plugins, using a combination of BM25 and vector search for hybrid retrieval.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a CLI.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse and reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3×. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to save up to 36% in token usage.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every result and uses a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps. It supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments and includes features for contradiction tracking and recency ranking.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing long-term memory as inspectable Markdown files. The system is daemonless and uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache to ensure memory remains local and transparent.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for the Hermes agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with specific evidence packets per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by watching agent session logs and storing data locally using SQLite-vec. It functions as an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts and context files like AGENTS.md before the context window opens to reduce prompt tokens. It employs a local-first architecture using SQLite and FTS5 with native Model Context Protocol support.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This plugin provides reflective memory through automated indexing of codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support. It utilizes semantic search, BM25 full-text retrieval, and ranked graph traversal to navigate bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer manages identity, decisions, and workflows for coding agents using plain Markdown files. It features a source-neutral migration workflow for documents and chats, supporting agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only provider uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with importance-weighted recall. It combines BM25 keyword search with optional GLiNER2 entity extraction to surface high-priority entries during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin implements a pull-model that supports immediate event deletion and on-demand summarization. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every memory operation and prefetch event.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across 29 chains, including EVM and Solana. It facilitates direct wallet settlements with 0% transaction fees for agent-to-API commerce.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, runbooks, scripts, and MCP configurations to improve agent routing. It provides five native tools for search and retrieval, using model calls to automatically generate tool routing notes.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin features pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It relies on a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage searching, remembering, and state updates.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and search. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to refine retrieval accuracy.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be deployed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin enables private local code memory for repositories through a required local SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid of BM25, vector, and graph search. It also features automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop that identifies data rot and contradictions within a git-backed directory of markdown files. It utilizes specific slash commands for memory capture and recall, generating evidence-cited JSON diffs for manual review to maintain memory hygiene without a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to facilitate autonomous task execution. It belongs in this list for its ability to enforce test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system enables the generation of prototypes, decks, and documents using real CSS and components. It is included for its native support of Hermes Agent and its compatibility with DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. It serves as a comprehensive security knowledge base compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts natural language, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while preserving manual layout adjustments. It adds value by enforcing architecture contracts through YAML/JSON rules and a Diagram-as-Test methodology.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments. It belongs here for adding a verification and dispute resolution layer to agent interactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It is a relevant skill for Hermes agents requiring rewrite, detect-only, or edit-in-place capabilities.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a shared, evolving library that natively integrates with Hermes and OpenClaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting skills and session traces to support collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library provides 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It is designed to maintain session state within a project's documentation directory for persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,169 skills for professional and life tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent. The skills are distributed as plain markdown files, making them easily portable and ready for immediate export.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists. It expands agent utility by providing structured access to YouTube data via a dedicated API.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects reusable patterns in active workflows to propose new skills. It streamlines development by generating both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It enhances agent performance by providing pre-built analytical lenses and reporting on potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for agentskills.io using Pydantic AI, enabling remote skill registries via Git and S3. It includes tools for reading bundled resources and executing scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It features a specialized spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models to ensure project readiness.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill allows agents to generate .lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It includes a tangler for extracting runnable files and automatically synchronizes source edits back into the primary literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Designed for long-running agents, this harness uses a mechanism kernel and Markdown-based recipes to manage work trees and immutable decision records. It implements the SLP cooperative-agent protocol to facilitate supervised team generations and cross-role handbacks.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project provides specialized tools for interacting with CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. It enables agents to integrate directly with oracle networks and specialized services like CRE and ACE.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven repository offers Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configurations specifically localized in Portuguese. All provided skills adhere to the SKILL.md format and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide specialized prompting guidelines and API integration for FLUX 3 video and image generation. The project includes a router to manage multi-step video workflows via Python and TypeScript clients.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned, agentskills.io-compliant instruction files. It links instructions directly to source lines or URLs and includes a full lifecycle for creating, testing, and exporting skills.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with built-in recursive dependency resolution. It features a Python client and CLI, alongside commerce capabilities powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Focused on autonomous execution, this skill manages complex multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking and decision logging. It includes built-in rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This local-first workflow language uses a Rust binary and four core verbs—infer, invoke, exec, and agent—to define intent as code. It executes tasks as a dependency graph with parallel processing and maintains local journals for auditability.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye provides a five-layer intelligent retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. The system is designed for efficiency and features graceful degradation if embedding models or specific dependencies are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only security skill employs three parallel subagents to conduct adversarial code reviews and identify edge cases. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is an ADHD-friendly execution system that uses MCP connections for agent-driven scheduling and system design. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web application and an Expo-based Android app.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes Hermes Agent prompts across multiple surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram, reducing token usage by 20–80%. it supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code. It supports five major programming languages and includes a tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and reproduction through multi-story task decomposition. It features mandatory evidence-based verification gates and a Python goal engine for managing persistent task states.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports the automatic registration of skill directories and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics, network analysis, and exploitation. It integrates 28 different frameworks and standards, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to handle real-world CVEs.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills add session management and worktree recovery capabilities to provide memory between agent conversations. The toolkit also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes utilities for detecting state drift.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible repository demonstrations using vhs or Playwright. It optimizes GIF files to remain under 8 MB and embeds the final rendered output directly into the project's README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical drift. It validates skills against runtime-specific profiles and monitors official frontmatter specifications to ensure long-term compatibility.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It uses a local evaluation framework involving LLM-judges and regression testing to gate the application of skill updates.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs and error tracking. It operates with zero outbound telemetry and includes an optional script for incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages environment-specific path routing and Python interpreter selection for Windows, Git Bash, and WSL. It ensures deterministic file operations and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses across multiple protocols including Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent environment.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates to confirm that a skill works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for creating bounty boards, buying context, and settling payments directly to wallets.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and produces structured summaries with specific action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for Douyin video transcription, document OCR, and e-commerce material generation. It also features a rule-based engine designed to remove machine-like phrasing from AI-generated text.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for Hermes and other AI coding agents, including both open-source and unfree binaries. It serves as a distribution point for developers using Nix to manage their agent environments and development tools.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It specifically enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This solution features a one-line installation script for running Hermes Agent within Termux environments on Android. It supports over 70 tools, persistent memory, and connectivity to both external providers and local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart enables Hermes Agent deployment on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS via Termux and iSH. It extends agent functionality with Telegram integration for voice and file messaging, alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access with configurable policies for web search and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes using REST, CLI, or MCP interfaces. It features AES-256-GCM encryption for its 69-entry credential catalog and supports more than 17 LLM provider integrations.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows for persistent state through mounted directories and supports building specific Hermes versions via build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with RBAC-controlled access and separate workspaces. It facilitates inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian. It is designed for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable package allows Hermes to run from USB drives without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents for fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It utilizes a researcher team to conduct bullish and bearish debates, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents for final approvals.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across Web UI, CLI, and REST API interfaces. It supports multi-agent workflows and can be installed locally via Node.js or deployed using Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, through TUI and web dashboards. It ensures persistent sessions via tmux integration and provides sandboxing through Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine manages Hermes agents and specialist teams using the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It is the first MCP engine on the Solana blockchain and features HTTP signal detection to handle payment-required states for APIs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework builds autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage agent team delegation and orchestration.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a centralized Kanban board and review queue. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized AI agents focused on research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via Hermes Kanban.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualized through a real-time dashboard and scoreboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling while performing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool maintains a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that synchronizes automatically as files change to reduce token usage and tool calls. It provides structural extraction for languages like TypeScript and Python, integrating directly with agents such as Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Gemini, via a Terminal User Interface. Users can visualize their consumption data and optionally submit it to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from coding agents like Hermes and Cursor while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions to facilitate detailed debugging of agent interactions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of token usage, costs, and rate limits for over 35 AI coding tools by reading agent states directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers historical breakdowns categorized by tool, model, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown and integrates with agents including Hermes, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 skills to streamline building and shipping applications. It supports autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments for consistent operations.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project provides community-driven themes and CLI skins to customize the Hermes terminal UI with unique colors, spinners, and ASCII art. Users can create their own aesthetics, such as retro DOS or cyberpunk, using simple YAML-based configurations.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform enables a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and facilitates commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports various providers like Anthropic and OpenAI while offering an undo function for recent agent changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory adapters for platforms like Slack and VS Code, supporting frameworks such as CrewAI and LangGraph. It utilizes a two-tier system consisting of knowledge graphs and session caches to enhance agent memory.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup uses RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and research, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes agents using per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while managing local skills and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that supports 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter that performs local, deterministic checks on agent configurations and system prompts without requiring LLM or API calls. It flags vague tool descriptions and missing retry budgets, supporting CI integration through SARIF output and baseline filtering.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility maps OpenClaw configurations, credentials, and memory archives into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the transition of SOUL.md and skills while setting up systemd gateway services for the new environment.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry from agent conversations without cloud dependencies. It features zero-token passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed as a local-first skill for generating revenue, this tool utilizes explicit approval contracts for external actions. It processes bounded JSON through stdin to manage opportunity and offer-preview workflows with exact-approval requirements.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This offline assistant provides voice capabilities for Hermes Agent, supporting 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro without API keys. It features adaptive turn-taking, barge-in capabilities, and an open mic with wake word detection.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for managing agent information. It includes a circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages and provides specific tools for adding, searching, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with Tauri 2, provides a desktop interface for Hermes Agent alongside other tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It is compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux, serving as an all-in-one desktop controller.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source cowork application that integrates Hermes Agent with dozens of other external agents in a single interface. It features 21 built-in professional assistants and enables remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built using Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web-based interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices. It includes a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the Hermes Agent experience through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard offers a visual workflow canvas with approval gates and unified configuration for 10 messaging platforms like Telegram and Discord. It tracks token consumption and execution history while storing session data in a local SQLite database.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated memory browser to manage agent skills and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop, server, or Docker-based environment. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and provides native iOS and Android clients for mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features native views for managing Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: This Windows-first desktop application is built with Tauri v2 and Rust, offering local process management and hosted runtime installation. It supports Feishu platform integration and renders complex content like LaTeX and Mermaid diagrams.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium extension connects active browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes via a side-panel interface. It features intelligent tab scoping and a Bot Mode for multi-agent switching and group chats.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that allows users to drive self-hosted Hermes agents and manage file system workspaces from a mobile device. It streams real-time responses, including tool-call and thinking details, via HTTPS or Tailscale.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace provides one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs. It includes a runtime dashboard to track performance metrics such as token usage and latency.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It includes a tmux operator view designed specifically for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that provides searchable transcripts and image browsing for over 14 agent formats. It operates locally without telemetry, offering an agent cockpit that attributes live quota burn to individual sessions for Codex and Claude.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent management.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative dashboard provides a text-based interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports task management through an integrated kanban board and allows users to manage profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs without admin rights or system-wide dependencies, offering a Tkinter GUI for local model interaction. It includes 100 tools for tasks like ComfyUI and music generation, featuring granular permission controls and session management.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes an integrated file browser and dedicated management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring by providing real-time tracking of session activity and costs. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations. The interface supports streaming SSE responses and allows for seamless model switching during chat.
